_doc: Inventory of third-party material, read by check_third_party.py and rendered as THIRD_PARTY.md. Each entry: name, paths (fnmatch globs; * crosses /), license (SPDX), source, notice (a tracked file, or "inline" when the notice is in the file itself), and copyleft_ok when the licence is copyleft or non-commercial. not_third_party lists files that trip a signal but hold no third-party material, each with why.

entries.name: E-invoicing Schematron rules compiled to JSON
entries.license: EUPL-1.2 AND Apache-2.0 AND MPL-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-only
entries.source: ConnectingEurope/eInvoicing-EN16931, itplr-kosit/xrechnung-schematron, OpenPEPPOL, phive-rules and others; NOTICE.txt names each set and its upstream commit
